about_blocks.text: The House of Sophrosyne: A Safe Haven for Women in Recovery
about_blocks.html: The House of Sophrosyne: A Safe Haven for Women in Recovery

about_blocks.text: The House of Sophrosyne is a women-run organization dedicated to helping women struggling with addiction to alcohol or other drugs. With a focus on providing an environment of understanding, our dedicated professionals offer a wide range of services to help our clients live a full, productive, and balanced life. The House is a safe place for women, providing a holistic approach grounded with our faith in empowering women to make positive and permanent lifestyle changes. Our innovative and transformative programs help to guide recovery and provide tools essential to our clients’ daily lives.

about_blocks.text: The House of Sophrosyne offers one on one counseling and transformative group work, with individualized treatment plans that focus on each individual’s unique needs and goals. Our holistic approach integrates different forms of therapy, including evidence-based therapies, such as cognitive-behavioral therapy, as well as experiential therapies like expressive arts, yoga, and meditation. We offer comprehensive continuing care services to ensure our clients have a kind of recovery that lasts a lifetime. Our services range from mental health issues to concerns over childcare, all of which affect our clients’ recovery.

about_blocks.text: At the House of Sophrosyne, we provide both residential and community-based programs. Our residential program, for women 16 years and older with a valid Ontario Health Card, is a 5-week program that adheres to Ontario Health/Publically Funded Bed’s principles and philosophy. We also provide a pre-treatment program that supports women while they are waiting for their services. Our client-centered harm reduction model is non-judgmental, and we provide seamless intervention in a timely manner.

about_blocks.text: We understand that a woman needing to access treatment can be faced with the insurmountable barrier of leaving. Here, at the House of Sophrosyne, we offer Caring Connections that help our clients to access treatment without leaving their families behind. Supportive Housing is a combination of housing and supportive services that help our clients to transition from treatment to independent living. We empower women by providing them with suitable housing options and offering them a step-by-step guide that helps them to manage their life after treatment.

about_blocks.text: House of Sophrosyne is a renowned private rehab center in Windsor, Ontario, that stands out due to its services specializing in the treatment of substance, drug and alcohol abuse. Providing top-of-the-line treatments and programs, the center caters to the needs of its clients and helps them in achieving the best results. The center believes that every individual must experience a healthy, fulfilled life, free from substance abuse, and therefore, offers an extensive range of amenities, therapies and evidence-based practices.
